HYPOTHETICAL CHEMISTRY EXAMPLE — Catalyst screening

A model substrate was reacted with catalyst C at a loading of 2 mol% in ethanol for 4 hours. At 60 °C, substrate conversion was 72%; at 80 °C, conversion was 91%. All experiments used the same initial substrate concentration of 0.10 mol/L. Conversion was measured by gas chromatography; isolated yields were not determined.
question: What substrate conversion was measured at 80 °C with 2 mol% catalyst C after 4 hours in ethanol?
answer: Substrate conversion was 91%, measured by gas chromatography.
